user.title: Connect to Sesharo
user.description: Push selected Home Assistant data into Sesharo. Create a Personal Access Token in the Sesharo app (Settings → Developer) and paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: Sesharo rejected the token or user ID. Double-check both.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Sesharo API at that URL.

abort.already_configured: This Sesharo account is already configured.

init.title: Sesharo options
init.description: Presets (temperature, humidity, CO₂, PM2.5, power, energy, presence/door/motion) are sent automatically. Add a custom mapping by entering an entity + a signal slug. Current custom mappings: {current}
